verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents reusable packages (Providers, Functions, and portable Configurations) that can be installed into a cluster. Its official CLI covers building, installing, updating and pushing those packages, so both consuming and publishing are first-party capabilities. However, the evidence never names a public registry or marketplace where packages are discovered and shared; the 'library of components' line is only marketing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a public package registry/marketplace, discovery/search of published packages, independent or hands-on corroboration of publish/consume workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can consume and publish reusable modules or components from a public registry
